source_review.notes: Checked current official Apache Avro specification; Protocol Buffers proto3 evolution guide; Apache Iceberg schema documentation/specification; Apache Flink state-schema, upgrade, savepoint, and Table/SQL documentation; Apache Beam schema guide; Apache Spark Structured Streaming guide; Apache Parquet logical-type documentation; and Apache Airflow backfill documentation. All twelve final references returned HTTP 200. Format/runtime-specific compatibility claims are attributed.

evidence: Reviewed writer/reader schemas, directional resolution, replay tuple, input snapshot, code/config/dependency, state/key, model/reference, time/nondeterminism, quality, and output-version notation.
Checked result function, writer-version coverage, differential result, default/unknown counts, and conditional publication versions with explicit scopes.
Checked that wire readability, state compatibility, semantic equivalence, output compatibility, and consumer compatibility remain distinct.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The model makes semantic bundle and replay intent part of result identity rather than treating schema compatibility as sufficient.

evidence: Executed the Python 3 fixture and reproduced two decoded records, one defaulted region, old total 3500 cents, new total 4000 cents, true semantic change, and output namespace orders_total/v2.
Recomputed old total as 1000 + 2500 = 3500 and new total as 1000 + floor(2500 * 120 / 100) = 4000.
Verified a 500-cent classified difference exists despite successful decoding and unchanged record count.
numerical_recomputation.notes: No universal schema compatibility mode, version retention, sample size, numerical tolerance, migration duration, canary interval, or rollback window is prescribed.

evidence: Verified per-writer directional resolution establishes declared-byte readability only and does not imply zero computational differential.
Verified pinned original schemas/code/state/model/reference/time bundle plus immutable inputs supports historical reproduction under explicit runtime/determinism premises.
Verified explicit state mapping plus equivalence invariant and atomic versioned publication preserves a migration, while changed transformation semantics require a distinct output identity.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Unavailable historical dependencies or nondeterministic behavior weaken reproduction claims and must be disclosed rather than silently replaced.

evidence: Reviewed all writer versions, missing/default/alias/unknown fields, reused field IDs/numbers, nested/union/null/enum data, numeric/decimal/time extremes, malformed bytes, and corrupt provenance.

Reviewed key collisions/splits, repartitioning, state serializer/operator/timer/topology changes, planner/runtime/dependency drift, mutable reference/model data, locale/time zone/rounding/order/randomness changes.
Reviewed mixed partitions, old/new consumers, effect identity, partial migration, cutover conflict, rollback under new state/output, and missing old artifacts.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Unknown, unsupported, collision-prone, or semantically unexplained combinations are quarantined, rebuilt, or rejected rather than coerced.

evidence: Traced original writer/field identity and semantic bundle through resolution, state mapping, computation, output version, consumer validation, publication, and rollback.
Checked never-reused field identity, explicit default/alias/promotion/null/logical-type meaning, conservative key migration, and exact operator/state/serializer ownership.
Checked pinned code/config/library/runtime/planner/model/reference/time inputs, distinct reproduction/reinterpretation identities, version-aware effects, and no accidental mixed-version result.
invariant_checking.notes: Current catalog schema, source commit alone, registry compatibility, auto-generated operator identity, or equal counts cannot establish these invariants.

evidence: Reviewed decode-safety, historical reproduction, migration preservation, and semantic-change arguments with coverage, resolution, artifact, determinism, identity, mapping, and atomicity premises.

Checked counterexamples for synthesized defaults, reused field IDs, key-as-value migration, latest-schema reads, state ID drift, floating dependencies, mutable lookups, and unversioned corrected output.
Checked adversarial tests span wire, state, code, time, reference, output, consumer, effect, publication, and rollback boundaries.
proof_review.notes: Representation preservation, logical-state preservation, business equivalence, and consumer safety use separately named relations and evidence.

evidence: Audited writer/reader schema, wire/state/semantic compatibility, semantic version, migration, reinterpretation, historical replay, dual read/write, compatibility matrix, and golden corpus terminology.
Confirmed defaulted versus producer-supplied values, name versus field identity, value versus key schema, logical versus physical type, and code versus full semantic bundle distinctions.
Confirmed reproduction, correction, state migration, rebuild, shadow execution, in-place upgrade, and consumer rollout are separate operations.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Avro, Protobuf, Iceberg, Flink, Beam, Spark, Parquet, and Airflow compatibility mechanisms are not presented as interchangeable.

evidence: Reviewed records/bytes by writer/reader/schema/code version, resolution/default/alias/promotion/unknown/corrupt counts, state migrations, key collisions, and restore results.
Reviewed differential key/value/order/timestamp/aggregate classes, golden/property/metamorphic outcomes, candidate coverage, consumer errors, performance, publication, and rollback.
Confirmed segmentation by input snapshot/partition, writer/reader/output/state/key schema, code/config/dependency/runtime/planner/model/reference version, intent, consumer, and time window.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Successful decode, equal counts, passing registry checks, or a successful restore is not mislabeled as semantic equivalence or safe publication.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed replay intent, version inventory, directional resolution, field/key/state identity, executable semantic bundles, code-change classification, compatibility matrices, historical/generated testing, output/effect versioning, migration topology, publication, rollback, and drift governance.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed implementable writer-schema scans, manifests/digests, default provenance, field/key mappings, operator/state/serializer records, reproducible builds, compatibility matrices, golden/differential/metamorphic/restore tests, shadow outputs, CAS publication, and rollback assets. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from replay intent and bytes through state and executable semantics to versioned output and cutover. Ten examples and five answered exercises cover defaults, IDs, promotions, key collisions, planner drift, floating dependencies, expected differences, shadow catch-up, effects, compatibility matrices, and rollback.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external Avro/Protobuf/Iceberg/Flink/Beam/Spark/Parquet/Airflow maintainer, schema/runtime/streaming/database/platform/SRE/security/governance specialist, production migration operator, downstream consumer, affected user, accessibility specialist, or certification review is claimed.
